stem:
Vivek marks endpoints X and Y. He finds two points P and Q so that each is the same distance from X as from Y. He draws the line through P and Q.

What is that line?

options.text: The line that must pass through the endpoints X and Y only.
A line that creates equal distances from X and Y after it is drawn.
The perpendicular bisector of segment XY.
A guide for tiling a rectangle with 2 by 1 tiles.

teacher.key_rationale: Two points each equidistant from X and Y determine the perpendicular bisector of XY. The equal-distance condition produces the line, not the other way round.
